name: object-type-reference-test-19fd51d776/object-inclusion-with-qualifiers-negative-e.bal
spec_references: ## Object/class definitions: Only `client`, `service` and `isolated` `object-type-quals` / `class-type-quals` are supported
## Expressions: [New expression](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#section_6.8.2) (object constructor expressions are not listed)
reason: The whole negative case includes distinct object type descriptors (Obj0, Obj1, Obj2 and FooObj), excluded by the object-type qualifier restriction, and object constructor expressions whose qualifier/inclusion diagnostics are asserted but which are absent from the supported expression list. These essential unsupported constructs suffice for feature classification.
unsupported_constructs: Object constructor expressions such as object Foo, object Bar, object Qux and object Corge
test_design_notes: Negative qualifier/inclusion and visibility diagnostics are asserted; illegality alone does not make a case unsupported.
Readonly/distinct class qualifier coverage conflicts between the positive class list and the restrictions; classification does not depend on resolving that conflict.
arr.toStream() and start actions are explicitly supported.
